name: Frac valve control unit
function: The hydraulic power unit, accumulator, and remote panel that operate the actuated valves on the tree and zipper manifold from outside the red zone.

tabs.overview: A diesel or electric hydraulic pump charges an accumulator; a panel with one control per valve opens and closes the actuators and shows position. Emergency shut-in closes the upper master and wing valves together.
tabs.engineering: Hydraulic supply pressure per the actuator design; accumulator volume sized for a full close of all valves on loss of the pump.
tabs.connections: Hydraulic hoses to each actuator; electrical control to the panel.
tabs.safety: Hydraulic lines are under pressure; leaks at the actuator are within the red zone and are repaired only after shut-in.
tabs.operations: Function test every valve before pumping; sequence the zipper and wing valves per stage; emergency shut-in drill before the first stage.
tabs.failure_modes: Hose leaks, accumulator precharge loss, position indicator faults.

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Hands clear of wing nuts, handwheels, and actuator linkages during operation.
